title: Quiz 1 — Chemical Reactions in Everyday Lives
revision: 2026-11 rev2 — 70:30 LOTS:HOTS, balanced choices, in-scope items only

questions.text: Which reaction type breaks ONE compound into two or more simpler substances?
options: Decomposition
Combustion
Acid + metal
Acid + carbonate

questions.text: What gas forms when an acid reacts with a metal such as zinc?
options: Hydrogen
Oxygen
Carbon dioxide
Chlorine

questions.text: Which of these is a CHEMICAL change?
options: Rice cooking and turning soft and sticky
Ice cubes melting in a tall glass of juice
Sugar dissolving in a cup of hot tea
A plastic bottle being crushed flat
questions.correct: Rice cooking and turning soft and sticky

questions.text: Why does baking soda fizz when vinegar is poured on it?
options: The acid and carbonate react to release CO₂
The vinegar boils as soon as it touches the soda
Air trapped in the powder is pushed out
The soda melts into water and then foams
questions.correct: The acid and carbonate react to release CO₂

questions.text: A candle burns with a steady flame. Which reaction type is this?
options: Combustion
Decomposition
Acid + metal
Neutralization only

questions.text: Why is a yellow, sooty LPG flame a warning sign?
options: It shows incomplete combustion, which can make CO
It shows the tank is too full of fresh fuel to burn well
It shows the flame is hotter and much safer
It shows the gas is turning into pure water
questions.correct: It shows incomplete combustion, which can make CO

questions.text: Hydrogen peroxide fizzing on a wound gives off which gas?
options: Oxygen
Hydrogen
Chlorine
Nitrogen

questions.text: A student adds dilute hydrochloric acid to crushed eggshells and holds a burning splint at the mouth of the tube. What will happen?
options: The flame goes out, because CO₂ formed
The gas pops loudly, because hydrogen formed
The flame glows brighter, because oxygen formed
Nothing happens, since eggshells cannot react
questions.correct: The flame goes out, because CO₂ formed

questions.text: Which product would you use to remove white scale (calcium carbonate) from a kettle, and why?
options: Vinegar, because acid reacts with carbonate
Salt water, because salt dissolves all minerals
Cooking oil, because oil softens the scale layer
Bleach, because it reacts with metal to clean it
questions.correct: Vinegar, because acid reacts with carbonate

questions.text: A family uses a charcoal stove inside a closed room during a storm. What is the GREATEST danger, and why?
options: Carbon monoxide, from incomplete combustion
Hydrogen gas, from charcoal reacting with rain
Oxygen gas, from the charcoal breaking down
Chlorine gas, from salt in the cooking food

questions.text: Why must you change only the coefficients, not the subscripts, when balancing an equation?
options: Changing subscripts makes a different substance
Subscripts are too small to be changed easily by hand
Coefficients always have to be odd numbers
Subscripts show the speed of the reaction
questions.correct: Changing subscripts makes a different substance

questions.text: What are the REACTANTS of photosynthesis?
options: Carbon dioxide and water
Glucose and oxygen gas
Oxygen and water vapor
Glucose and carbon dioxide

questions.text: In which organelle does most cellular respiration happen?
options: Mitochondria
Chloroplasts
Ribosomes
Nucleus

questions.text: Why are photosynthesis and respiration called opposite processes?
options: The products of one are the reactants of the other
Both need sunlight and happen only during the daytime
Both produce glucose and release carbon dioxide
One happens in plants and the other only in rocks
questions.correct: The products of one are the reactants of the other

questions.text: What is ATP?
options: The energy currency of the cell
A sugar made in the chloroplast
A gas released during breathing
A mineral absorbed by the roots
questions.correct: The energy currency of the cell

questions.text: Muscles burn during a hard sprint because cells make which substance when oxygen runs short?
options: Lactic acid
Glucose
Ethanol
Oxygen gas (O₂)

questions.text: Which is an example of CATABOLISM?
options: Breaking down starch into glucose
Building proteins from amino acids
Making new cells during growth
Storing extra glucose as glycogen

questions.text: Which coefficients balance __CH₄ + __O₂ → __CO₂ + __H₂O?
A sealed jar has a plant and a mouse. In bright light both stay healthy for a while; in darkness the mouse weakens sooner. What BEST explains this?
options: In darkness the plant stops making oxygen but still uses it
In darkness the plant makes more oxygen for the mouse
In darkness the mouse stops respiring and saves all its oxygen
In darkness carbon dioxide turns back into oxygen
questions.correct: In darkness the plant stops making oxygen but still uses it

questions.text: Yeast is added to two cups of sugar water. Cup A is warm; Cup B is ice-cold. Cup A foams much more. What is the BEST conclusion?
options: Warmth speeds up yeast fermentation, making more CO₂
Cold water dissolves more CO₂, so it makes more foam
Sugar only dissolves in warm water, not in cold water
Yeast performs photosynthesis faster in warm water
questions.correct: Warmth speeds up yeast fermentation, making more CO₂
